question: How many open claims does each North adjuster have?

report.interpretation: Open claims (status = 'open' on the 2026-09-30 extract) currently assigned to each adjuster whose region is North, counting all report dates. Adjusters are as listed in the adjusters table.
report.answer: The 7 North adjusters hold 126 open claims in total. Jacqueline Smith (ADJ-023) has the most with 22. Adam Sanchez (ADJ-024) and Joshua Miller (ADJ-027) have 20 each. Abigail Foster (ADJ-026) and Charles Robinson (ADJ-028) have 18 each. Charles Price (ADJ-022) and Jamie Jones (ADJ-025) have 14 each. None of the North adjusters has left the company.
report.answer_sql: select a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, count(c.claim_id) open_claims from adjusters a left join claims c on c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id and c.status='open' where a.region='North' group by all order by open_claims desc, a.adjuster_id
